featured_reviews.name: Srush Jagdale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience with the eyebrow service at Enrich Palladium.

I had called in advance to book an appointment, and the man on the phone confirmed that my appointment had been scheduled. However, when I arrived, there was apparently no proper appointment in place and I was effectively treated as a walk-in customer.

The eyebrow service itself was even more disappointing. The technician did not ask a single question about how I wanted my eyebrows shaped or maintained before starting. There was no consultation, no effort to understand my preferences, and no communication throughout the process.

The end result was terrible. My eyebrows were done poorly, and the shape was far from what I would have expected from a professional salon. What made the experience worse was the complete lack of communication—there was no explanation of what was being done, no discussion of any concerns, and no attempt to address the obvious issues with the final result.

For a salon that promotes itself as a premium service provider, the lack of professionalism, attention to detail, and basic customer communication was unacceptable.
